findings.observation: The page displays level 4, Adventuring, Tanvu, Kojan. Details lists Oki as starter and hand-in, Tanvu as starting zone, Shang Village series and location -16408, -49970, 187. Avenging Oki instead places Oki at -16529, -49889, 194 in its notes. These remain separate page-specific coordinate observations without a canonical spawn merge.

The primary objective says Search Kojuko Pillagers for Oki's Jewel. Description explicitly instructs speaking to Oki, slaying Kojuko Pillager's northeast until one drops Oki's Jewels, then returning to Oki. This supplies a source-specific kill/drop account, but no required kill count or drop probability. Notes use Kujuko Pillager and describe Level 4 (Demonic, Imp, 2 dot, aggro); the fandom variant uses Kojukko and Kojuko. These spellings are preserved without canonical creature identity matching.

The fandom objective prints Oki's Jewels (1) and a boathouse-ransacking narrative. Details separately lists Items needed Oki's Jewels. The explicit (1) is retained as the fandom account's item quantity, not a kill count or proof of an operative server requirement. Primary objective singular Jewel and plural Jewels elsewhere remain source-specific text.

One recorded disagreement concerns ends npc, attributed to wiki.silkyvenom.com:80. Details and description say return to Oki, but the alternate turn-in value is absent. The disagreement query was not fetched; turn-in remains unresolved.

Previous Avenging Oki reciprocates that page's Next Oki's Jewels. Next is Lost Fishing Supplies. These are displayed navigation, not verified enforced prerequisites. Repeatable No and Rating 7.0 are explicit source observations; rating is not a game statistic.

Coin reward 40 lacks a denomination, so copper remains unknown. Reward Dusk Charm has an embedded tooltip with Soulbound, No Sell, Misc, Item Level: 1, a required-class list and cannot be deconstructed. This is tooltip evidence, not a fetched item detail or inspected screenshot. Binding trigger and reward-choice mechanics are unknown.

The page attributes its source to the vgoemulator.net archived MMODB Oki's Jewels URL and preserves fandom and crawler variants. Original bodies were not fetched in this review. Archived mirrors and archive transcriptions do not count as independent corroboration.
